How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IISER Thiruvananthapuram Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 04-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Junior Research Fellow position at IISER Thiruvananthapuram?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow position is 04-10-2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a post-graduate degree in biological sciences from a recognized university with a first-class academic record to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 35 years. There might be age relaxations for certain categories as per government rules, which are detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 31,000 plus HRA. There is also a provision for an upgrade to Senior Research Fellow (SRF) at the start of the third year.

faq.question: Q5. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates need to apply by sending their complete application along with all necessary documents via email to the designated email address mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an online interview followed by document verification. Candidates are advised to prepare accordingly for both stages.

faq.question: Q8. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow position in this recruitment drive by IISER Thiruvananthapuram.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Junior Research Fellow is on a contract basis, offering a valuable opportunity for research experience.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification and other relevant details can be found on the official website of IISER Thiruvananthapuram. A direct link to the notification is usually provided in the 'Important Links' section of recruitment portals.
